pages.name: Getting Started Guide
pages.content:
## ✨ Overview
**ClickUp is an all-in-one productivity platform.** It’s where teams come together to plan, organize, and collaborate on work using tasks, Docs, Whiteboards, and more, all in **one place.**
ClickUp Dev gives you a _single place_ inside ClickUp where your development teams can come together to plan and execute on their work. This helps each team have their own place to manage their work, while still rolling up into one unified project roadmap.

Use this solution to manage your product and engineering teams who use Sprints for completing work.

**Note:** click on any of the images/gifs to expand them for a closer look.

## [What is ClickUp Dev?](https://clickup.wistia.com/medias/a8v50ol1rr)

ClickUp Dev can be setup for one or more development teams, with each team having their own team **Folder** to plan their team's projects and backlogs, as well as execute on that work.

This solution also includes built-in documentation, with a place for teams to align on processes, create team wikis, and add meeting notes.

Easily add additional teams to your development Space.

Select either a **Sprint team** (using sprints to manage work) or a **Kanban team**, who uses a backlog and an active List to manage work.

In this help guide, we'll focus on teams that use a **Sprints** for managing work.

![](https://t90152566819.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t90152566819/f7dd7bb0-cbaa-4353-a23f-3cb68a3b4b45/Export-1719002069692.gif)
![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/7d46f087-d56d-467f-abdb-8a95ea3dbe6d/image.png)

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/dfb82839-7388-4801-b8ff-156480ba8839/image.png)

**To get the most out of ClickUp Dev, we recommend setting up your Github, GitLab, or BitBucket Integration.**

Find detailed set up information below for each of these integrations.

[GitHub Integration](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6305771568791-GitHub-integration)

[GitLab Integration](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6305774858263-GitLab-integration)

[BitBucket Integration](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6305592182423-Bitbucket-integration)

## [Welcome to your backlog](https://clickup.wistia.com/medias/wdt17xfcfx)

Let's dive into your backlog! This is where you plan your upcoming work.

Let's start by creating a task, setting the priority, and estimating the level of effort..

**Note:** use [sprint points](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6303883602327-Use-Sprint-Points) to designate sizing!

Link this task to its parent project on the **Projects** List from the **Backlog** view.

Once your backlog is planned, you can easily add any of these stories to planned Sprints by using the "**Add to Sprint**" button

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/cd741c4d-2436-4456-9c57-638354ecc67b/image.png)

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/a1859302-7aef-4e4d-a5ca-8c530287279f/CU%20Dev%20Kanban%20Create%20task.gif)

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/4289b3ce-2f07-4473-ba98-6e799181e35e/CU%20Dev%20Kanban%20Link%20Task.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/6a8b83e9-14ff-4b7d-ba8d-902f44910d92/Export-1719335823297.gif)

## Triage and plan bug fixes

Submit bugs using the bug reporting Form. This ensures that all information needed to triage and investigate bugs is collected, and a bug task is automatically created.

Gather additional details and triage bug reports. Once they're ready to be fixed, use the "**Add to Sprint**" button to add them to an upcoming Sprint.

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/9c7d55d3-6da3-4e38-9227-2db61f7079ad/Export-1719011032680.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/ef996fb7-60ea-4b99-a666-e2a0168e65dc/Export-1719335451059.gif)

## Start Sprints

Once you're in your current Sprint, you can easily add tasks from the backlog.

Use these Sprint buttons as filter shortcuts to ensure that all user stories are assigned and have sprint points.

Once all work has been added to the Sprint and all items have sprint points and assignees, confirm your Sprint! This locks your forecasted effort to inform your Dashboards and reporting.

Easily move work from one status to another on the included Kanban board as you complete your work.

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/8d27bb3d-f61e-4ce9-9ed9-4deeff0beaa3/Export-1723640837485.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/17fc5421-2f88-455a-b47b-7ff280d36884/Export-1723641337834.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/cd9d59b3-e7e7-4007-bb08-a4090d1dc8b9/Export-1723642532321.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/e7283c63-5538-4f08-8fdc-512c715515dd/Export-1719003771516.gif)

## [Reporting and tracking](https://clickup.wistia.com/medias/mug1jvp214)

**Folder (Team) Dashboard**
On the Folder level, you'll see a more holistic Dashboard that includes work in the backlog.

Drill down into any card to see more details, and even open a task and engage with your team as needed.

Any of these Dashboards can be customized based on your preferences to show you the information most relevant to you and your teams.

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/e7d83a50-b2a1-41b0-bd78-557c0acf8567/CU%20Dev%20Team%20Dashboard.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/4f738e1c-1bee-41d8-adc6-ede4e7440bc3/Export-1719005346278.gif)

pages.name: User Research Plan
pages.content:
A user research plan provides structure and consistency in defining the goals and details required to conduct effective user research. It keeps all stakeholders aligned throughout the project. This ClickUp template will help UX teams communicate, plan, and execute - ultimately helping them understand users' behaviors, needs, and motivations so that they can deliver the best product and solutions. # 🔑 Overview Provide the key details in the table below. | **Project Name** | **Launching Self-Service Features** | | ---| --- | | **ClickUp Project** | _\[Link to the ClickUp location of the project\]_ | | **Team Channel** | _\[Link to the collaboration group chat/channel, if applicable\]_ | | **Project Manager** | @mention the project manager | | **UX Researcher** | @mention the lead UX Researcher | ## Problem Statement What is the overarching topic or problem statement of this entire user research project? > _To increase user retention and reduce operating costs by enabling more self-service features_ * 70% of negative customer feedback collected in the last 6 months mentioned lack of self-service capabilities in the comments * Since launching 6 months ago, the churn rate has hovered at around 10%, which is higher than the acceptable churn rate # 🎯 Goals What are the objectives of conducting this research? What are you trying to better understand through this research? What questions are you trying to answer? What knowledge gaps are you trying to fill? What qualitative and quantitative measures can be used to test results? ## Phase ## Objectives ## Measures * * * Discovery 1️⃣ Understand what challenges and pain points users experience around our product's current lack of self-service features, and whether they drive users to our competitors * Feedback score * Comments * Competitor comparisons Discovery 2️⃣ Understand what administrative features users need the most in order to prioritize product development efforts * Feature ranking * Comments Concept 3️⃣ Test usability of the design proof of concept for the administrative feature * Success score * Error rate * Task time * Single Ease Question (SEQ) * Observations Product Testing 4️⃣ Gather feedback on the customer's experience on the prototype of the administrative feature * Feedback score * Comments # 🤔 Hypotheses What are your hypotheses and assumptions? Make sure your hypotheses are testable. * Launching new self-service product features will increase user adoption and retention * Self-service product features will increase overall customer satisfaction with our product * Self-service product features will reduce the volume of customer support inquiries related to administration, resulting in a reduction in operating costs # ✍️ Research Design What specific questions will test your hypotheses? What method will be used to conduct the research? Who are the target participants? ## Objectives 1 & 2 1. _Understand what challenges and pain points users experience around our product's current lack of self-service features, and whether they drive users to our competitors_ 2. _Understand what administrative features users need the most in order to prioritize product development efforts_ | **Questions** | **Method(s)** | **Participants** | | ---| ---| --- | |

ClickUp Dev can be setup for one or more development teams, with each team having their own team **Folder** to plan their team's projects and backlogs, as well as execute on that work.

Select either a **scrum team** (using sprints to manage work) or a **kanban team**, who uses a backlog and an active List to manage work.

In this help guide, we'll focus on teams that use a **Kanban method** of managing work.

![](https://t90152566819.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t90152566819/f7dd7bb0-cbaa-4353-a23f-3cb68a3b4b45/Export-1719002069692.gif)

**To get the most out of ClickUp Dev, we recommend setting up your Github, GitLab, or BitBucket Integration.**

**Find detailed set up information below for each of these integrations.**

[GitHub Integration](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6305771568791-GitHub-integration)

## [Welcome to your backlog](https://clickup.wistia.com/medias/1y2mz61qif)

Let's dive into your backlog! This is where you plan your upcoming work.

Let's start by creating a task, estimating the level of effort, and setting the priority.

**Note:** you can use the T-Shirt sizing Custom Field, or even [sprint points](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6303883602327-Use-Sprint-Points) to designate sizing!

Link this task to its parent project on the `Projects List` from the tasks view.

Every task in your Backlog list is visible in your Kanban List and can be managed in either location.

**Note:** pre-defined Automations will keep your tasks in both your backlog and Kanban List

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/0e99e3eb-066d-4f82-b605-1b4d073d1ac3/CU%20Dev%20Backlog.gif)

## Triage and plan bug fixes

Submit bugs using the bug reporting Form. This ensures that all information needed to triage and investigate bugs is collected, and a bug task is automatically created.

Gather additional details and triage bug reports. Once they're ready to be fixed, set them to an active status to automatically add them to the active work List.

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/9c7d55d3-6da3-4e38-9227-2db61f7079ad/Export-1719011032680.gif)

![](https://t333.s.clickup-attachments-stg.com/t333/11cd8c4b-7e7c-4545-84c2-9469d4b8097f/Export-1719011635389.gif)

## [Dig into active work](https://clickup.wistia.com/medias/xlr0pne80u)

Now that your tasks and bugs are ready to be worked on, you can assign work to your team members.

Assign work by clicking the assignee icon and typing the name of the person you'd like to assign the item to!

Choose [Work in Progress limits](https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6304619369623-Work-in-Progress-Limits) for each status in your Kanban view.

Easily move work from one status to another as you complete your work.

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/cf6cd522-e5b2-472b-9df8-293c664797d0/CU%20Dev%20Kanban%20Assignees.gif)

## [Reporting and tracking](https://clickup.wistia.com/medias/jga8nl13d6)

**Kanban Dashboard**
Track your team's active work progress at any time from your Dashboard.

This active work Dashboard enables you to quickly see overall progress on your active work and how that work is distributed across your team.

Any of these Dashboards can be customized based on your preferences to show you the information most relevant to you and your teams.

![](https://t90152566819.p.clickup-attachments.com/t90152566819/dea22e20-84a3-48fa-880d-3b574146147a/CU%20Dev%20Kanban%20Team%20Dashboard.gif)
